style: Courtside, not corporate. Flat, confident, athletic energy over live volleyball footage. Yellow-on-transparent with a flat dark offset shadow, no soft glows or hairlines: legibility over unpredictable video is the constraint. The share card's lockup: wordmark, MEDIA and the tagline (nino, 2026-10-12). The play mark is never inside the d, and the symbol and the wordmark+symbol lockup are still open gates in forge-brand, so this sting carries no play mark (nino, 2026-10-12).
font: Peridot PE 950 (the locked wordmark), shipped as PNG letter layers. MEDIA in JetBrains Mono 500 and the tagline in Anton 400, the site's own label and headline faces, as live text from vendored OFL woff2 files (assets/vendor/fonts).

customize.why_hand_authored: Hand-authored. The 2026-07 version re-sequenced logo-outro around a play triangle nested in the d; that construction is ruled out, and per-letter layers need no catalog block.

content.layout: The share card's lockup, centred in the 1080x1920 frame as one column: the wordmark 800 px wide (74% of the frame, inside the overlay kit's validated x 122-940 safe area), about 195 px tall at Peridot's ~4.1:1; MEDIA under it at 38 px, spaced 0.5em; then the tagline on two lines, EVERY DAY'S A / FLICKDAY., Anton 133 px. The card's proportions scaled to an 800 px mark, except MEDIA, which is larger so it reads on a phone. The group's centre sits at 46% of the frame height (y ~883), clear of the bottom quarter where Reels and TikTok draw their buttons. Each letter is a PNG layer sharing the full mark's box and scales about its own ink centre (origins in assets/wordmark/layers.js).
content.motif: Letter cascade, then the line. The word builds left to right the way it reads, MEDIA settles under it, the tagline rises a line at a time, the lockup holds flat, the tagline and MEDIA leave, and the word clears left to right the way it arrived. No symbol.

motion.letter_build: per letter, stagger 0.06s from 0.15s: scale 0 -> 1 (power3.out, never past 1), y +36 -> 0 (back.out(2.2)), opacity 0 -> 1 (power2.out, 0.3s). The snap lives on the vertical lift: any scale overshoot fuses the tight k|d and d|a pairs of the heavy face.
motion.media_in: at 0.86s, as the last letters land: y +14 -> 0 and opacity 0 -> 1 (power2.out, 0.36s).
motion.tagline_in: per line, 0.12s apart from 1.08s: y +48 -> 0 and opacity 0 -> 1 (power3.out, 0.5s). No scale, so nothing overshoots.
motion.hold: static, flat, legible: the money frame for compositing, 1.70-3.50s. No ambient motion.
motion.tagline_out: per line, 0.06s apart from 3.50s: y 0 -> -24 and opacity 1 -> 0 (power2.in, 0.3s); MEDIA fades out at 3.66s (0.3s).
motion.letter_retract: per letter, stagger 0.05s from 3.85s: scale 1 -> 0 and opacity 1 -> 0 (power2.in, 0.44s), left to right.

beat_table.motion: staggered grow + lift, left to right
lift + fade, MEDIA first, then a line at a time
lift + fade out, top line first
staggered collapse + fade, left to right
canvas fully empty; guarantees a clear final frame for CapCut

build_notes: The wordmark is Peridot PE 950, lowercase, standard cut, as eight registered PNG layers from scripts/build-sting-wordmark.mjs (run from the repo root; needs network for the Adobe Fonts kit and ImageMagick). Each layer is the full mark's canvas with one letter's ink; stacked they redraw the one-piece mark, and the script refuses to write layers that do not.

The wordmark is PNG, not SVG or live text: Peridot is licensed for live text, not for embedded outlines (BRAND-PRIORS.md), and the PNG layers keep the render free of the Adobe Fonts kit. MEDIA and the tagline are live text in Anton and JetBrains Mono, both SIL OFL, vendored as local woff2 files so the render makes no network fetch. Their fallback is monospace on purpose, so a failed load shows.
Layers are drawn at 1600 px, twice the 800 px the sting shows, so no frame upscales them.
No play mark in the d, and no play mark beside the wordmark until the symbol and lockup gates close (nino, 2026-10-12). The traced play-d SVG this sting used before is removed.

LEGIBILITY-OVER-FOOTAGE: the mark is pure yellow #facc15 on transparent with a FLAT, zero-blur 6 px offset shadow in dark ink #111318 down and right, NEVER a soft glow. The shadow was an option until nino asked for it on 2026-10-12, after yellow lost contrast over white sky and a white board. It sits on each letter, not the word, so a fading letter fades with its own shadow instead of showing it through. 4 px thinned to a hairline at phone size; 10 px read as an extrusion. The tagline is white, which has no hue to fall back on over white sky, so it also carries a flat dark outline (6 px stroke painted under the fill, so 3 px shows), and MEDIA a 4 px one under a 3 px shadow. Without the outline, over a light frame only the shadow was left to read (2026-10-12). Do not bake in any other backing; the compositor owns placement.
Final delivery is ProRes 4444 MOV (alpha): a render-flag detail for the CLI, not a composition change.

Tagline added on 2026-10-12, when nino made "Every Day's a Flickday." the site's headline and asked for it in this sting; MEDIA came with it, the lockup nino chose for the share card the same day. The string is exact (render standard gate 3).
shot_brief: A 5s transparent bookend sting for CapCut compositing over volleyball footage: the Peridot wordmark builds letter by letter, left to right, each letter growing in place with a small upward snap; MEDIA settles under it and the tagline, Every Day's a Flickday., rises a line at a time; the lockup holds flat and legible; then the tagline and MEDIA leave and the word collapses letter by letter in the same direction. Frame 0 and the final frame are fully clear so it drops cleanly onto footage. No URL, no symbol. Rendered as an alpha overlay, final delivery ProRes 4444 MOV.
